WORKSHOPS.chapel.//: The Village chapel (an idea Cam approved in note 13: 'the Paladin's tutor, holy water, and a bless-your-weapon service'; Part 8 and 9 left it for later; built 16 October when Cam painted it). Sister Maren, the Paladin's tutor, sells holy water -- a flask blesses your blade from the bag, as it always has (one way to bless). Switching to the Paladin stays at the Guild hall (one home).
WORKSHOPS.chapel.name: The Chapel
WORKSHOPS.chapel.says: Sit a while, if you like. And take some holy water for the road -- a blessed blade bites the dead.
